sn48.68:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ rukkhā, pāricchattako tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn48.68:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhikā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati: yadidaṃ bodhāya.
sn48.68:1.4: saddhindriyaṃ bhikkhave, bodhipakkhikodhammo. taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati
sn48.68:1.8: paññindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiko dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
sn48.68:1.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ rukkhā, pāricchattako tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
